rally_outcome.name: rally_outcome_sequence_v3.json
rally_outcome.purpose: Rally winner and in/out/net from the shuttle and players around the last contact, the camera-placed landing and the last shot's 3D flight fit; trained on ShuttleSet and DShuttleNet broadcast matches; validation winner 90.5% singles and 91.5% doubles with the published last hit, 89.6% singles and 87.0% doubles end to end; unvalidated on amateur footage

singles_event_ensemble.name: events_singles_ensemble_v1.ts
singles_event_ensemble.base: events.pt 4d2a8b54973396f4254108141e47c8a17858b0ba595be21e60b6336f74b5e981 (contact, hitter, side and serve outputs)
singles_event_ensemble.terms: Trained on ShuttleSet and AI CUP features; research data terms apply
singles_event_ensemble.format: TorchScript; returns (hit, hitter, family, side, serve) logits for one 30 fps singles view
singles_event_ensemble.purpose: Singles stroke families as the mean of three frozen family heads; one frozen held-out test check passed (ShuttleSet test matches 39-44 at +/-2 frames: 1687 vs 1666 of 1998 known matched contacts, six-family macro F1 .8227 vs .8144; AI CUP test groups also passed); independent whole-match accuracy unvalidated

doubles_stroke_window.name: events_doubles_window_v1.pt
doubles_stroke_window.terms: Fine-tuned on DShuttleNet features (CC BY-NC-SA 4.0): non-commercial use only
doubles_stroke_window.architecture: badminton/stroke_window.py; family logits blended 0.65 events_doubles.pt + 0.35 window at calibrated contacts
doubles_stroke_window.purpose: Doubles stroke families from a four-player window around each contact; one frozen held-out test check passed (DShuttleNet test matches at +/-2 frames: 3173 vs 3090 of 4057 known matched contacts, six-family macro F1 .8033 vs .7743; S2 Doubles match 3 also passed); independent whole-match accuracy unvalidated
